## 렌더링

```bash
# Python (네트워크 필요)
pip install plantuml
python -c "from plantuml import PlantUML; p=PlantUML('https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml/png/'); \
  import os; [p.processes_file(f, outfile='rendered/'+os.path.basename(f).replace('.puml','.png')) \
              for f in sorted(__import__('glob').glob('*.puml'))]"

# Docker
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/data plantuml/plantuml -tpng '*.puml'

# VS Code
PlantUML 확장 → Alt+D 미리보기
```
audit-topics.md 원문 보기
# Kafka Audit / History / Event Topic 사양

| 항목 | 값 |
|---|---|
| Document ID | ECS-KAFKA-V1.2 |
| Priority | P1 |
| Bound to | D2 §7.4, D6 openapi.yaml |
| Status | DRAFT — Phase 3에서 상세화 |

## 사용 범위

- **Audit**: Core ↔ Extension 모든 호출 audit.
- **History**: phase 전이 history, cmd ledger.
- **Event**: domain별 비동기 이벤트.

REST/gRPC와 달리 Kafka는 **비동기 / 리플레이 가능**. business decision은 절대 Kafka 메시지에 의존하지 않는다.

## Topic 일람

| Topic | Partition Key | Retention | 용도 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ecs.audit.v1` | `wi_ref` | 30d | 모든 RPC/REST 호출 audit |
| `ecs.history.phase.v1` | `wi_ref` | 1y | phase 전이 |
| `ecs.history.cmd.v1` | `cmd_id` | 1y | cmd ledger |
| `ecs.event.scheduler.v1` | `wi_ref` | 30d | queue tier 전이 |
| `ecs.event.dispatcher.v1` | `wi_ref` | 30d | dispatch 결정 |
| `ecs.event.eta_etw.v1` | `wi_ref` | 7d | ETA/ETW 갱신 |
| `ecs.event.gate.v1` | `gate_id` | 30d | Gate 이벤트 |
| `ecs.event.ocr.v1` | `camera_id` | 7d | OCR raw 결과 |
| `ecs.event.bms.v1` | `agv_id` | 7d | BMS telemetry |
| `ecs.event.reefer.v1` | `reefer_id` | 30d | Reefer 알람 |
| `ecs.event.lstp.v1` | `operation_id` | 30d | LSTP 작업 |

## 메시지 envelope

모든 메시지는 다음 공통 envelope 사용:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0",
  "messageId": "<uuid>",
  "occurredAt": "2026-06-10T12:34:56.789Z",
  "producer": "ecs-core / ext-gate / ...",
  "type": "<event type>",
  "payload": { /* type별 schema */ },
  "correlation": {
    "wiRef": "WI-2026-0001",
    "containerWiRef": "CWI-2026-0001-A",
    "requestId": "req-2026-0001"
  }
}
```

## payload 스키마 (발췌)

### audit

```json
{
  "type": "RPC_CALL" | "REST_CALL",
  "direction": "IN" | "OUT",
  "endpoint": "/api/v1.2/work-instructions",
  "method": "POST",
  "statusCode": 200,
  "latencyMs": 42,
  "errCd": null
}
```

### history.phase

```json
{
  "type": "PHASE_TRANSITION",
  "wiRef": "WI-2026-0001",
  "containerWiRef": "CWI-2026-0001-A",
  "fromPhase": "J01",
  "toPhase": "J02",
  "result": "ACCEPT" | "REJECT",
  "errCd": null
}
```

### history.cmd

```json
{
  "type": "CMD_LEDGER",
  "cmdId": "a1b2c3d4e5f60718",
  "wiRef": "WI-2026-0001",
  "phase": "J04",
  "seq": 3,
  "equipmentId": "AGV-12",
  "action": "ISSUE" | "ACK" | "ROLLBACK" | "CANCEL"
}
```

### event.dispatcher

```json
{
  "type": "DISPATCH_DECISION",
  "decision": "QC_SELECTED" | "ARMG_SELECTED" | "AGV_SOFT_RESERVED" | "AGV_HARD_ASSIGNED" | "NO_CANDIDATE",
  "equipmentId": "QC-03",
  "explanation": "pool match + workQueue min + bay match"
}
```

## Partition / Replication

| 설정 | 권고값 |
|---|---|
| partitions | 12 (audit / history) · 6 (event) |
| replication.factor | 3 |
| min.insync.replicas | 2 |
| compression | lz4 |

## Consumer 권장 패턴

- Consumer group 1개 = 1 consumer 책임 (audit 적재 / history 적재 / dashboard 등).
- replay 가능 — offset reset 시 1y 데이터까지 재처리.
- 절대 Kafka 메시지로 **business decision을 분기하지 않는다** — decision은 REST/gRPC 동기 호출에서 끝낸다.

## 보안

- TLS 필수.
- ACL — Producer는 ecs-core 또는 ext-* 서비스 계정만.
- Consumer는 적재/대시보드 계정만.
openapi.yaml 원문 보기
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: ECS Core ↔ Extension REST API (v1.3, Matrix v1.1 반영)
  version: 1.3.0
  description: |
    ECS v1.3 외부 인터페이스 사양.
    Matrix v1.1 (2026-06-10) 답변/확정 방향에 따라 정정됨.

    ## 사용 범위
    - TOS-FMS → ECS Core (WI 입력)
    - ECS Core ↔ Extension Service (Gate / OCR / LSTP / BMS / Reefer)
    - ECS Core ↔ AGV-FMS (위치 조회 / ETW 전달) — **Matrix #8 신규**
    - ECS Core → TOS 에뮬레이터 (taskNo Notify) — **Matrix #21 신규**

    ## Core 내부는 gRPC, audit/history는 Kafka
    - 본 OpenAPI는 외부/Extension REST 한정
    - gRPC: `core.proto` 참조
    - Kafka: `audit-topics.md` 참조

    ## 인증
    - 외부 (TOS-FMS, OPENSG): API key + mTLS 권장
    - Extension: mTLS + service account

  contact:
    name: ECS Architecture
    email: ecs-arch@cyberlogitec.example

servers:
  - url: https://ecs.example.com/api/v1.3
    description: Production
  - url: https://ecs-staging.example.com/api/v1.3
    description: Staging

tags:
  - name: WorkInstruction
    description: TOS-FMS ↔ ECS Core (WI 송수신)
  - name: TaskStatus
    description: Task 상태 조회
  - name: TaskNo
    description: AGV taskNo Notify (ECS → TOS 에뮬레이터)
  - name: AgvPosition
    description: AGV 위치 조회 (ECS → FMS)
  - name: ETW
    description: ECS가 계산한 ETW 전달 (ECS → FMS)
  - name: Gate
    description: Gate Extension
  - name: OCR
    description: OCR Extension
  - name: LSTP
    description: LSTP Extension (슬롯 예약/해제)
  - name: BMS
    description: BMS Extension
  - name: Reefer
    description: Reefer Extension
  - name: STS_Bridge
    description: STS-AGV 매개 인터페이스 (C02-AODR / C02-TRPT)

security:
  - apiKey: []

paths:

  # ============================================================
  # WorkInstruction
  # ============================================================
  /work-instructions:
    post:
      tags: [WorkInstruction]
      summary: WI 송신
      operationId: createWorkInstruction
      description: |
        TOS-FMS가 ECS에 WI를 송신.

        **Matrix #1**: 동시 메시지 개수는 유동적 (작업 Plan에 따라)
        **Matrix #2**: 크레인별 그룹화
        **Matrix #3**: 우선순위는 `orderseq` 그대로 사용
        **Matrix #6**: POW에 따라 QC/YC 라우팅
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateWIRequest'
            examples:
              ds_two_containers:
                summary: DS WI 2 컨테이너 (v1.3 정정본)
                value:
                  header:
                    wiRef: "WI-2026-0001"
                  body:
                    - containerWiRef: "CWI-2026-0001-A"
                      wiType: "DS"
                      truckTp: "OT"
                      pointOfWork: "QC"
                      craneId: "STS-01"
                      orderseq: 1
                      fromDoorDirection: "H"
                      toDoorDirection: "H"
                      doorDirectionOnTruck: "L"
                      fromSlot: "VES-01-H"
                      toSlot: "PLAT-01"
                    - containerWiRef: "CWI-2026-0001-B"
                      wiType: "DS"
                      truckTp: "OT"
                      pointOfWork: "QC"
                      craneId: "STS-01"
                      orderseq: 2
                      fromDoorDirection: "N"   # 저장 허용
                      toDoorDirection: "N"     # 장비 전송 시 L로 변환
                      doorDirectionOnTruck: "L"
                      fromSlot: "VES-01-L"
                      toSlot: "PLAT-02"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: |
            정상 수신 — Batch 부분 성공 패턴 (D2 §9.4).
            개별 WI 검증 실패는 200 응답의 `result.rejected[]`에 담겨 반환된다.
            (envelope 자체 파싱 실패 등 전체 실패만 400/5xx)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateWIResponse'
        '400':
          description: |
            envelope 자체 실패 (요청 JSON 파싱 불가, 인증 실패 등).
            개별 WI 검증 실패는 200/`result.rejected[]` 경로 사용.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'

  /work-instructions/{containerWiRef}:
    get:
      tags: [TaskStatus]
      operationId: getTaskStatus
      parameters:
        - name: containerWiRef
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 정상
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskStatusResponse'

  # ============================================================
  # taskNo Notify (Matrix #21 — 신규 인터페이스)
  # ============================================================
  /tos-emu/taskno:
    post:
      tags: [TaskNo]
      summary: AGV taskNo 통보 (ECS → TOS 에뮬레이터)
      operationId: notifyTaskNo
      description: |
        **Matrix #21 신규 인터페이스**

        AGV에 보낼 `taskNo`를 ECS가 생성한 후, TOS 에뮬레이터로 역전달.
        `commandId = containerWiRef` 동시 통보.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskNoNotify'
            example:
              containerWiRef: "CWI-2026-0001-A"
              commandId:      "CWI-2026-0001-A"
              taskNo:         "T-01HW4Z9YJ8M5XXX"
              agvId:          "AGV-12"
              generatedAt:    "2026-06-10T12:34:56.789Z"
      responses:
        '202':
          description: accepted

  # ============================================================
  # AGV Position (Matrix #8 — 신규 인터페이스)
  # ============================================================
  /fms/agv/{agvId}/position:
    get:
      tags: [AgvPosition]
      summary: AGV 현재 위치 조회 (ECS → FMS)
      operationId: getAgvPosition
      description: |
        **Matrix #8 신규 인터페이스**

        ECS Core가 ETA 계산을 위해 AGV 위치를 조회.
      parameters:
        - name: agvId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 정상
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AgvPosition'

  # ============================================================
  # ETW Push (Matrix #8 — 신규 인터페이스)
  # ============================================================
  /fms/etw:
    post:
      tags: [ETW]
      summary: ECS 계산 ETW를 FMS로 전달
      operationId: pushEtw
      description: |
        **Matrix #8 신규 인터페이스**

        ECS Core가 계산한 ETW를 FMS로 전달.
        FMS는 AGV dispatch 시점 결정에 활용.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EtwPush'
      responses:
        '202':
          description: accepted

  # ============================================================
  # STS Bridge (Matrix #17 — C02-AODR / C02-TRPT)
  # ============================================================
  /sts/bridge/aodr:
    post:
      tags: [STS_Bridge]
      summary: C02-AODR (STS → ECS) AGV 작업 위치 도착 여부 질의
      operationId: c02_aodr
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/C02_AODR_Request'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 응답
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/C02_TRPT_Response'

  # ============================================================
  # Gate Extension (Matrix #10, #11)
  # ============================================================
  /core/xt/arrived:
    post:
      tags: [Gate]
      summary: XT(외부 트럭) 도착 통보 (Gate → Core)
      operationId: xtArrived
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/XtArrived'
      responses:
        '202':
          description: accepted

  /core/xt/departed:
    post:
      tags: [Gate]
      summary: XT 출차 통보 (Gate → Core)
      operationId: xtDeparted
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/XtDeparted'
      responses:
        '202':
          description: accepted

  # ============================================================
  # OCR Extension (Matrix #10, #11, #23)
  # ============================================================
  /core/ocr/result:
    post:
      tags: [OCR]
      summary: 컨테이너 OCR 판독 결과 (OCR → Core)
      operationId: ocrResult
      description: |
        OCR Extension은 raw 결과만 전달.
        매칭 / exchange 결정은 Core가 수행 (Matrix #23).
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OcrResult'
      responses:
        '202':
          description: accepted

  # ============================================================
  # LSTP Extension (Matrix #10) — 슬롯 예약/해제
  # ============================================================
  /core/lstp/slot/reserve:
    post:
      tags: [LSTP]
      operationId: lstpReserve
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/SlotReserve'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 예약 성공
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SlotReserveResponse'

  /core/lstp/slot/release:
    post:
      tags: [LSTP]
      operationId: lstpRelease
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/SlotRelease'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 해제 성공

  # ============================================================
  # BMS Extension
  # ============================================================
  /core/bms/soc:
    post:
      tags: [BMS]
      summary: 배터리 SOC telemetry (BMS → Core)
      operationId: bmsSoc
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BmsSoc'
      responses:
        '202':
          description: accepted

  /core/bms/agvs/{agvId}/soc:
    get:
      tags: [BMS]
      operationId: getBmsSoc
      parameters:
        - name: agvId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 정상
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BmsSoc'

  # ============================================================
  # Reefer Extension
  # ============================================================
  /core/reefer/alarm:
    post:
      tags: [Reefer]
      summary: Reefer 알람 raw 통보 (Reefer → Core)
      operationId: reeferAlarm
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReeferAlarm'
      responses:
        '202':
          description: accepted

components:
  securitySchemes:
    apiKey:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-API-Key

  schemas:
    # ───── WI ─────
    CreateWIRequest:
      type: object
      required: [header, body]
      properties:
        header:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/WIHeader'
        body:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WIEntry'

    WIHeader:
      type: object
      required: [wiRef]
      properties:
        wiRef:
          type: string
          description: TOS 발행 WI 식별자

    WIEntry:
      type: object
      required:
        - containerWiRef
        - wiType
        - truckTp
        - pointOfWork
        - craneId
        - orderseq
        - fromDoorDirection
        - toDoorDirection
      properties:
        containerWiRef:
          type: string
          description: |
            컨테이너별 unique 식별자 (MUST).
            commandId로도 사용. OCR 변경 시에도 유지.
        wiType:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/WIType'
        truckTp:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TruckTp'
        pointOfWork:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/POW'
        craneId:
          type: string
          description: 크레인 식별자 (Scheduler 그룹 키)
        orderseq:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          description: |
            크레인별 작업 시퀀스 (Matrix #3).
            ECS는 이 값으로 정렬.
        fromDoorDirection:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Direction'
        toDoorDirection:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Direction'
        doorDirectionOnTruck:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Direction'
        fromSlot:
          type: string
        toSlot:
          type: string
        bay:
          type: string

    WIType:
      type: string
      enum: [DS, LD, GI, GO, RH, MI]

    TruckTp:
      type: string
      enum: [YT, AT, OT]
      description: |
        Canonical. OTR은 adapter에서 OT로 normalize.

    POW:
      type: string
      enum: [QC, YC]
      description: |
        Point of Work. 작업 단계에 따라 YC↔QC 업데이트 (Matrix #6).

    Direction:
      type: string
      enum: [H, L, N]
      description: |
        Door direction.
        N = UNKNOWN. 저장 허용, 임의 추정 금지.
        장비 전송 시 N → L 디폴트 변환 (Matrix #15).
        FRONT/REAR/F 입력 시 3001 reject.

    # ============================================================
    # WI Batch Response (D2 §9.4, D4 §1.1 정합)
    # ============================================================
    CreateWIResponse:
      type: object
      description: |
        WI Batch 응답 — 부분 성공(partial success) 패턴.
        `accepted`와 `rejected`는 같은 응답에 공존할 수 있다.
        SSOT: D2 §9.4 / D4 §1.1.
      required: [result]
      properties:
        result:
          type: object
          required: [accepted, rejected]
          properties:
            accepted:
              type: array
              description: 정상 처리된 WI 목록 (빈 배열 허용)
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AcceptedEntry'
            rejected:
              type: array
              description: 검증 실패한 WI 목록 (빈 배열 허용)
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RejectedEntry'

    AcceptedEntry:
      type: object
      description: 정상 수신된 WI 항목 (D2 §9.4.3)
      required: [containerWiRef]
      properties:
        containerWiRef:
          type: string
          description: WI 식별자 (idempotency key)
          example: "CWI-2026-0001-A"
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [queued, dispatching, in_progress, completed]
          description: (선택) 수신 직후 상태 스냅샷
        craneId:
          type: string
          description: (선택) 배정된 크레인 ID
        orderseq:
          type: integer
          description: (선택) WI orderseq

    RejectedEntry:
      type: object
      description: 검증 실패한 WI 항목 (D2 §9.4.3, D4 §1.1)
      required: [containerWiRef, errCd, errDesc]
      properties:
        containerWiRef:
          type: string
          description: 어떤 WI가 reject 되었는지 식별
          example: "CWI-2026-0001-B"
        errCd:
          type: string
          enum: ["1001", "2001", "3001"]
          description: |
            D4 Common Error Catalog 등록 코드.
            Matrix #14 초기 3개 — 신규 코드는 D4 §1.3 절차로만 추가.
          example: "3001"
        errDesc:
          type: string
          description: errCd와 1:1 매핑 (D4 §1.2 기준)
          example: "Validation Failed"
        ctx:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorContext'

    ErrorContext:
      type: object
      description: |
        디버깅용 부가정보 (선택, 권장).
        D2 §9.4.3 기준: 실패 필드명 + 실패 시점 입력 값.
        추가 필드는 허용 (additionalProperties: true).
      properties:
        field:
          type: string
          description: 실패 필드명
          example: "fromDoorDirection"
        value:
          description: 실패 시점의 입력 값 (타입 불문)
          example: "FRONT"
      additionalProperties: true

    TaskStatusResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        containerWiRef: { type: string }
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [queued, dispatching, soft_reserved, hard_assigned, in_progress, completed, cancelled, failed]
        equipmentId: { type: string }
        trolley:
          type: string
          enum: [main, second, none]
        etw:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        eta:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        phase:
          type: string
          description: J02-TODR / S03-ARPT / J04-TODR 등

    # ───── taskNo Notify (Matrix #21) ─────
    TaskNoNotify:
      type: object
      required: [containerWiRef, commandId, taskNo, agvId, generatedAt]
      properties:
        containerWiRef: { type: string }
        commandId:
          type: string
          description: containerWiRef와 동일값
        taskNo:
          type: string
          description: ECS 생성. 예 "T-01HW4Z9YJ8M5XXX"
        agvId: { type: string }
        generatedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    # ───── AGV Position (Matrix #8) ─────
    AgvPosition:
      type: object
      properties:
        agvId: { type: string }
        position:
          type: object
          properties:
            x: { type: number }
            y: { type: number }
            zone: { type: string }
        speed: { type: number, description: "m/s" }
        heading: { type: number, description: "degree" }
        reportedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    # ───── ETW Push (Matrix #8) ─────
    EtwPush:
      type: object
      required: [containerWiRef, equipmentId, etw]
      properties:
        containerWiRef: { type: string }
        equipmentId: { type: string }
        phase: { type: string }
        etw:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        cycleTime:
          type: string
          description: ISO 8601 duration (예 PT45S)
        buffer:
          type: string
          description: ISO 8601 duration

    # ───── C02-AODR / C02-TRPT (Matrix #17) ─────
    C02_AODR_Request:
      type: object
      required: [containerWiRef, agvId]
      properties:
        containerWiRef: { type: string }
        agvId: { type: string }
        stsId: { type: string }

    C02_TRPT_Response:
      type: object
      properties:
        agvId: { type: string }
        arrived: { type: boolean }
        position:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AgvPosition'

    # ───── Gate ─────
    XtArrived:
      type: object
      required: [xtId, gateId, arrivedAt]
      properties:
        xtId: { type: string }
        gateId: { type: string }
        truckTp:
          type: string
          enum: [OT, YT]
        wiRef: { type: string, nullable: true }
        arrivedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    XtDeparted:
      type: object
      required: [xtId, gateId, departedAt]
      properties:
        xtId: { type: string }
        gateId: { type: string }
        departedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    # ───── OCR (Matrix #23) ─────
    OcrResult:
      type: object
      required: [cameraId, containerWiRef, recognizedContainerNo, capturedAt]
      properties:
        cameraId: { type: string }
        containerWiRef:
          type: string
          description: 예상 컨테이너 식별자 (WI 기준)
        recognizedContainerNo:
          type: string
          description: OCR raw 인식 결과. 매칭/exchange 결정은 Core.
        sealNo:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        damageDetected:
          type: boolean
          default: false
        confidence:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 1
        capturedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    # ───── LSTP ─────
    SlotReserve:
      type: object
      required: [slotId, containerWiRef, requestedBy]
      properties:
        slotId: { type: string }
        containerWiRef: { type: string }
        requestedBy: { type: string }

    SlotReserveResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        slotId: { type: string }
        reservationId: { type: string }
        expiresAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    SlotRelease:
      type: object
      required: [slotId, reservationId]
      properties:
        slotId: { type: string }
        reservationId: { type: string }

    # ───── BMS ─────
    BmsSoc:
      type: object
      required: [agvId, soc, reportedAt]
      properties:
        agvId: { type: string }
        soc:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
          description: SOC (%)
        soh:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
        voltage: { type: number, nullable: true }
        temperature: { type: number, nullable: true }
        reportedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    # ───── Reefer ─────
    ReeferAlarm:
      type: object
      required: [reeferId, alarmType, occurredAt, raw]
      properties:
        reeferId: { type: string }
        alarmType:
          type: string
          description: raw 알람 type. action 결정은 Core.
        occurredAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        raw:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    # ───── Error (단일 실패 응답 — non-Batch 경로) ─────
    # WI Batch (POST /work-instructions) 는 RejectedEntry 사용.
    # 본 ErrorResponse 는 단일 리소스 조회/조작이 전체 실패한 경우 (4xx/5xx) 사용.
    # SSOT: D2 §9.4 (Batch), D4 §1.2 (코드 정의).
    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      required: [errCd, errDesc]
      properties:
        errCd:
          type: string
          enum: ["1001", "2001", "3001"]
          description: |
            D4 Common Error Catalog 등록 코드.
            Matrix #14 초기 3개 — 신규 코드는 D4 §1.3 절차로만 추가.
          example: "3001"
        errDesc:
          type: string
          description: errCd와 1:1 매핑 (D4 §1.2 기준)
          example: "Validation Failed"
        ctx:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorContext'
core.proto 원문 보기
// ============================================================
// ECS Core Internal gRPC API v1.3 (Matrix v1.1 반영)
//
// 사용 범위: Core 내부 모듈 (Scheduler / Dispatcher / ETA·ETW / State Manager)
// 외부 노출 X. 외부 인터페이스는 openapi.yaml 참조.
//
// 본 .proto는 모든 enum이 Canonical Dictionary (D3 v1.1)와 정확히 일치.
// 변경 시 Dictionary v1.x bump 동반.
// ============================================================
syntax = "proto3";

package ecs.core.v1;

option go_package = "github.com/cyberlogitec/ecs/core/v1;corev1";
option java_package = "com.cyberlogitec.ecs.core.v1";
option java_multiple_files = true;

import "google/protobuf/timestamp.proto";
import "google/protobuf/duration.proto";
import "google/protobuf/struct.proto";

// ============================================================
// Enums — Canonical Dictionary D3 v1.1
// ============================================================

enum WIType {
  WI_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  WI_TYPE_DS = 1;
  WI_TYPE_LD = 2;
  WI_TYPE_GI = 3;
  WI_TYPE_GO = 4;
  WI_TYPE_RH = 5;
  WI_TYPE_MI = 6;
}

enum TruckTp {
  TRUCK_TP_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  TRUCK_TP_YT = 1;
  TRUCK_TP_AT = 2;
  TRUCK_TP_OT = 3;  // OTR → adapter normalize → OT
}

enum POW {
  POW_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  POW_QC = 1;  // → STS
  POW_YC = 2;  // → ARMG
}

enum Direction {
  DIRECTION_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  DIRECTION_H = 1;
  DIRECTION_L = 2;
  DIRECTION_N = 3;  // UNKNOWN — 저장 허용, 장비 전송 시 L로 변환 (Matrix #15)
}

enum Trolley {
  TROLLEY_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  TROLLEY_MAIN = 1;
  TROLLEY_SECOND = 2;
  TROLLEY_NONE = 3;  // ARMG / AGV는 단일
}

enum TaskStatus {
  TASK_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  TASK_STATUS_QUEUED = 1;
  TASK_STATUS_DISPATCHING = 2;
  TASK_STATUS_SOFT_RESERVED = 3;
  TASK_STATUS_HARD_ASSIGNED = 4;
  TASK_STATUS_IN_PROGRESS = 5;
  TASK_STATUS_COMPLETED = 6;
  TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED = 7;
  TASK_STATUS_FAILED = 8;
}

enum EquipmentType {
  EQUIPMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  EQUIPMENT_TYPE_STS = 1;   // 더블트롤리
  EQUIPMENT_TYPE_ARMG = 2;
  EQUIPMENT_TYPE_AGV = 3;
}

enum AgvTaskStatus {
  AGV_TASK_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  AGV_TASK_STATUS_APPROACH = 1;
  AGV_TASK_STATUS_ARRIVE = 2;
}

enum ErrorSource {
  ERROR_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  ERROR_SOURCE_TOS_FMS = 1;
  ERROR_SOURCE_STS = 2;
  ERROR_SOURCE_ARMG = 3;
  ERROR_SOURCE_OCR = 4;
  ERROR_SOURCE_BMS = 5;
  ERROR_SOURCE_REEFER = 6;
  ERROR_SOURCE_GATE = 7;
  ERROR_SOURCE_LSTP = 8;
  ERROR_SOURCE_AGV_FMS = 9;
}

// ============================================================
// Common message types
// ============================================================

message ErrorData {
  // Matrix #14: 외부는 1001/2001/3001, 내부는 협의 후 확장
  string err_cd = 1;
  string err_desc = 2;
  ErrorSource src = 3;
  google.protobuf.Struct ctx = 4;
}

message WIHeader {
  string wi_ref = 1;
}

message WIEntry {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;        // commandId 동일값
  WIType wi_type = 2;
  TruckTp truck_tp = 3;
  POW pow = 4;                         // Matrix #6
  string crane_id = 5;                 // Matrix #2 그룹 키
  int32 orderseq = 6;                  // Matrix #3 우선순위
  Direction from_door_direction = 7;
  Direction to_door_direction = 8;
  Direction door_direction_on_truck = 9;
  string from_slot = 10;
  string to_slot = 11;
  string bay = 12;
}

message Task {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;
  string command_id = 2;               // = container_wi_ref
  string task_no = 3;                  // ECS 생성 (AGV 전송용)
  string wi_ref = 4;
  WIEntry entry = 5;
  TaskStatus status = 6;
  string equipment_id = 7;
  Trolley trolley = 8;                 // STS 전용
  google.protobuf.Timestamp etw = 9;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp eta = 10;
  string phase = 11;                   // J02-TODR / S03-ARPT / J04-TODR
  int32 retry_count = 12;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp queued_at = 13;
}

// ============================================================
// Scheduler Service (Matrix #1~#5)
// ============================================================
service SchedulerService {
  // WI fan-out + crane-grouped queue 적재
  rpc IngestWI(IngestWIRequest) returns (IngestWIResponse);

  // 크레인별 큐 head pull (orderseq asc 순서)
  rpc PullNext(PullNextRequest) returns (PullNextResponse);

  // task 상태 업데이트
  rpc UpdateTaskStatus(UpdateTaskStatusRequest) returns (UpdateTaskStatusResponse);

  // 크레인별 큐 깊이 조회 (모니터링)
  rpc GetQueueDepth(GetQueueDepthRequest) returns (GetQueueDepthResponse);
}

message IngestWIRequest {
  WIHeader header = 1;
  repeated WIEntry entries = 2;
}

message IngestWIResponse {
  message Accepted {
    string container_wi_ref = 1;
    TaskStatus status = 2;
    string crane_id = 3;
    int32 orderseq = 4;
  }
  message Rejected {
    string container_wi_ref = 1;
    ErrorData error = 2;
  }
  repeated Accepted accepted = 1;
  repeated Rejected rejected = 2;
}

message PullNextRequest {
  string crane_id = 1;                 // 필수 (크레인별 큐)
  Trolley trolley = 2;                 // STS의 경우 main/second 구분
  int32 max_items = 3;
}

message PullNextResponse {
  repeated Task tasks = 1;
}

message UpdateTaskStatusRequest {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;
  TaskStatus new_status = 2;
  string phase = 3;
  string equipment_id = 4;
  Trolley trolley = 5;
  ErrorData error = 6;
}

message UpdateTaskStatusResponse {
  Task task = 1;
}

message GetQueueDepthRequest {
  string crane_id = 1;
}

message GetQueueDepthResponse {
  int32 main_depth = 1;
  int32 second_depth = 2;
  int32 total_depth = 3;
}

// ============================================================
// Dispatcher Service (Matrix #6~#7, #21~#22)
// ============================================================
service DispatcherService {
  // task 1건 dispatch 수행
  rpc Dispatch(DispatchRequest) returns (DispatchResponse);

  // AGV Soft → Hard 승격
  rpc PromoteToHard(PromoteToHardRequest) returns (PromoteToHardResponse);

  // AGV cancel / rollback
  rpc CancelAssignment(CancelAssignmentRequest) returns (CancelAssignmentResponse);

  // AGV Swap 처리 (Matrix #22)
  rpc HandleAgvSwap(HandleAgvSwapRequest) returns (HandleAgvSwapResponse);

  // taskNo 생성 (Matrix #21)
  rpc IssueTaskNo(IssueTaskNoRequest) returns (IssueTaskNoResponse);
}

message DispatchRequest {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;
}

message DispatchResponse {
  enum Decision {
    DECISION_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
    DECISION_QC_SELECTED = 1;          // POW = QC → STS
    DECISION_ARMG_SELECTED = 2;        // POW = YC → ARMG
    DECISION_AGV_SOFT_RESERVED = 3;
    DECISION_AGV_HARD_ASSIGNED = 4;
    DECISION_NO_CANDIDATE = 5;
    DECISION_REJECTED = 6;
  }
  Decision decision = 1;
  string equipment_id = 2;
  Trolley trolley = 3;
  string task_no = 4;                  // AGV의 경우 발급
  ErrorData error = 5;
  string explanation = 6;
}

message PromoteToHardRequest {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;
  string agv_id = 2;
}

message PromoteToHardResponse {
  string task_no = 1;
  bool success = 2;
  ErrorData error = 3;
}

message CancelAssignmentRequest {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;
  enum Reason {
    REASON_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
    REASON_J02_REJECT_LATE = 1;
    REASON_AGV_REJECT = 2;
    REASON_OPERATOR_CANCEL = 3;
    REASON_TIMEOUT = 4;
    REASON_AGV_SWAP = 5;               // Matrix #22
  }
  Reason reason = 2;
}

message CancelAssignmentResponse {
  bool success = 1;
  string rolled_back_task_no = 2;
}

// Matrix #22 — 복수 AGV APPROACH 시 도착 순서 어긋남
message HandleAgvSwapRequest {
  string approached_agv_id = 1;
  string sts_id = 2;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp approached_at = 3;
}

message HandleAgvSwapResponse {
  bool swap_performed = 1;
  string from_task = 2;                // 원래 head task
  string to_task = 3;                  // 먼저 도착한 AGV의 task
}

message IssueTaskNoRequest {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;
  string agv_id = 2;
}

message IssueTaskNoResponse {
  string task_no = 1;                  // 예 "T-01HW4Z9YJ8M5..."
}

// ============================================================
// ETA / ETW Service (Matrix #8)
// ============================================================
service EtaEtwService {
  rpc ComputeEtw(ComputeEtwRequest) returns (ComputeEtwResponse);
  rpc ComputeEta(ComputeEtaRequest) returns (ComputeEtaResponse);

  // 외부 ETW 통보 수신 (Core가 입력 신호로만 수용 후 재계산)
  rpc IngestExternalEtwSignal(IngestExternalEtwSignalRequest)
      returns (IngestExternalEtwSignalResponse);
}

message ComputeEtwRequest {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;
  string equipment_id = 2;
  string phase = 3;
}

message ComputeEtwResponse {
  google.protobuf.Timestamp etw = 1;
  google.protobuf.Duration cycle_time = 2;
  google.protobuf.Duration buffer = 3;
}

message ComputeEtaRequest {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;
  string agv_id = 2;
}

message ComputeEtaResponse {
  google.protobuf.Timestamp eta = 1;
  google.protobuf.Duration travel_time = 2;
  google.protobuf.Duration congestion_delay = 3;
  google.protobuf.Duration battery_adjustment = 4;
}

message IngestExternalEtwSignalRequest {
  string equipment_id = 1;
  string phase = 2;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp external_etw = 3;
  ErrorSource src = 4;
}

message IngestExternalEtwSignalResponse {
  google.protobuf.Timestamp recomputed_etw = 1;
}

// ============================================================
// State Manager Service (Matrix #17, #21, #22, #23)
// ============================================================
service StateManagerService {
  // STS 더블트롤리 - Gate 획득 / 해제
  rpc TryAcquireSlot(TryAcquireSlotRequest) returns (TryAcquireSlotResponse);
  rpc ReleaseSlot(ReleaseSlotRequest) returns (ReleaseSlotResponse);

  // J-event / AT-event ledger 추가
  rpc AppendLedger(AppendLedgerRequest) returns (AppendLedgerResponse);

  // ledger 조회
  rpc GetLedger(GetLedgerRequest) returns (GetLedgerResponse);

  // Matrix #23 — OCR exchange 처리
  rpc RecordOcrExchange(RecordOcrExchangeRequest) returns (RecordOcrExchangeResponse);
}

message TryAcquireSlotRequest {
  string equipment_id = 1;
  Trolley trolley = 2;                 // STS의 경우 main/second 구분
  string container_wi_ref = 3;
}

message TryAcquireSlotResponse {
  bool acquired = 1;
  string current_holder = 2;
}

message ReleaseSlotRequest {
  string equipment_id = 1;
  Trolley trolley = 2;
  string container_wi_ref = 3;
}

message ReleaseSlotResponse {
  bool released = 1;
}

message AppendLedgerRequest {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;
  string event = 2;                    // J02-TODR / S03-ARPT / J04-TODR / AT-JS001 / AT-JR001 / AGV_SWAP / OCR_EXCHANGE
  google.protobuf.Struct ctx = 3;
}

message AppendLedgerResponse {
  bool success = 1;
}

message GetLedgerRequest {
  string container_wi_ref = 1;
}

message GetLedgerResponse {
  message Entry {
    google.protobuf.Timestamp at = 1;
    string event = 2;
    google.protobuf.Struct ctx = 3;
  }
  repeated Entry entries = 1;
}

// Matrix #23 — OCR 컨테이너 변경 시 exchange ledger
message RecordOcrExchangeRequest {
  string container_wi_ref_a = 1;
  string container_wi_ref_b = 2;
  string original_container_no_a = 3;
  string actual_container_no_a = 4;
  string detected_by_camera = 5;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp detected_at = 6;
}

message RecordOcrExchangeResponse {
  string exchange_id = 1;
}
